results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if outbound delivery is required vs activity logging)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm expectations before using HUBSPOT_CREATE_EMAIL (this logs an engagement record, not guaranteed delivery).
[Optional (if contact record ID is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Locate the target contact using HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA (select best match, capture contact ID).

[Optional (if unsure which engagement fields are writable)] [Prerequisite]: Inspect writable properties using HUBSPOT_READ_ALL_PROPERTIES_FOR_OBJECT_TYPE (email object type; avoid read-only/unknown fields).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Assemble the email payload for HUBSPOT_CREATE_EMAIL (set subject/body, direction/status as needed, timestamp in ms, and map sender/recipient info appropriately).
[Required] [Step]: Create the 1:1 email engagement using HUBSPOT_CREATE_EMAIL (capture created email object ID; use HUBSPOT_CREATE_EMAILS only when batching many logs).

[Optional (if the engagement must appear on a specific record timeline)] [Next Step]: Discover the correct associationTypeId using HUBSPOT_LIST_ASSOCIATION_TYPES, then link using HUBSPOT_CREATE_OBJECT_ASSOCIATION.
[Optional (for verification/audit)] [Next Step]: Read back the engagement using HUBSPOT_READ_EMAIL (confirm key properties and associations display as expected).

[Optional (if HUBSPOT_CREATE_EMAIL returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR)] [Fallback]: Re-check writable fields using HUBSPOT_READ_ALL_PROPERTIES_FOR_OBJECT_TYPE and retry HUBSPOT_CREATE_EMAIL with only validated properties.
known_pitfalls: [HUBSPOT_CREATE_EMAIL] 400 VALIDATION_ERROR if fields are not nested under the top-level properties object.
[HUBSPOT_CREATE_EMAIL] Timestamp must be milliseconds; seconds can place the activity at an unexpected time.
[HUBSPOT_READ_ALL_PROPERTIES_FOR_OBJECT_TYPE] Helps avoid 400 VALIDATION_ERROR codes for unknown or read-only properties.
[HUBSPOT_CREATE_EMAIL] 400 VALIDATION_ERROR if setting derived recipient fields directly; prefer using the email-headers JSON property for sender/recipients.
[HUBSPOT_CREATE_OBJECT_ASSOCIATION] 400 VALIDATION_ERROR if associationTypeId is incorrect; association create responses may not reliably echo labels, so confirm via HUBSPOT_READ_EMAIL.

HUBSPOT_CREATE_EMAIL.description: Creates a new HubSpot email engagement record. REQUIRED FIELDS in properties dict: - hs_email_subject: Subject line - hs_email_html: HTML content - hs_timestamp: Unix timestamp in milliseconds - hs_email_direction: One of 'EMAIL', 'INCOMING_EMAIL', 'FORWARDED_EMAIL', 'DRAFT_EMAIL' This creates an email engagement/activity record in HubSpot CRM, not a marketing email.

properties.description: Email properties to set. Keys are HubSpot internal property names. REQUIRED fields: 'hs_email_subject' (subject line), 'hs_email_html' (HTML content), 'hs_timestamp' (Unix timestamp in milliseconds), 'hs_email_direction' (one of: 'EMAIL', 'INCOMING_EMAIL', 'FORWARDED_EMAIL', 'DRAFT_EMAIL'). This creates an email engagement/activity record in HubSpot CRM.

HUBSPOT_READ_EMAIL.description: Call this to retrieve an existing HubSpot email by its `emailId` or an alternative unique `idProperty`.

emailId.description: The unique identifier (HubSpot ID) of the email object to retrieve, or the value of the `idProperty` if specified.

archived.description: Set to true to retrieve only archived email objects.

idProperty.description: Name of an alternative unique property to identify the email if not using `emailId`.

properties.description: Specific email properties to include; non-existent properties are ignored.

associations.description: Object types (e.g., 'contact', 'company') for associated IDs; non-existent associations are ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: Email properties for which to retrieve historical values; non-existent properties are ignored.

HUBSPOT_CREATE_EMAILS.description: Creates multiple HubSpot emails in a single batch operation.

properties.description: Email properties to set. Keys are HubSpot internal property names.

items.description: Request schema for creating individual emails within a batch operation.

inputs.description: List of email objects to create.
